stories.title: Implement Responsive Clubhouse Layout Structure
stories.goal: create a consistent, responsive layout structure for the league clubhouse
stories.benefit: all pages maintain visual consistency and adapt properly to different screen sizes
acceptanceCriteria: Layout uses responsive grid system that adapts to mobile, tablet, and desktop viewports
Layout includes designated areas for header, left-side navigation, main content, and optional right sidebar
Layout maintains consistent spacing, padding, and margins across all breakpoints
Layout uses CSS Grid or Flexbox for flexible, maintainable structure
Layout respects mobile-first design principles with progressive enhancement
Layout handles dynamic content heights without breaking visual structure

stories.title: Build Left-Side Navigation Menu
stories.goal: access all major league pages from a persistent left-side navigation menu
stories.benefit: I can quickly navigate to any section of the league clubhouse without searching
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation menu displays on left side of layout on desktop and tablet viewports
Menu includes links to all primary league pages (Feed, Matchups, Power Rankings, Transactions, etc.)
Current page is visually highlighted in navigation menu
Menu items include icons or visual indicators for improved scannability
Menu remains visible and accessible while scrolling page content
Menu collapses to hamburger menu on mobile devices with slide-out drawer

stories.title: Create League Switcher Header Component
stories.goal: see the current league context and access league switcher from the header
stories.benefit: I always know which league I'm viewing and can easily switch between leagues
acceptanceCriteria: Header displays prominently at top of all pages within league clubhouse layout
Header shows current league name and optional logo/icon
Header includes league switcher trigger for multi-league users
Header integrates with global navigation and user profile controls
Header remains fixed or sticky at top of viewport for constant visibility
Header design adapts to mobile viewports with appropriate responsive behavior

stories.title: Implement Mobile-Responsive Navigation
stories.goal: access all navigation features on my mobile device with touch-optimized controls
stories.benefit: I have a seamless navigation experience regardless of device
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation converts to hamburger menu icon on mobile viewports (typically < 768px)
Hamburger menu triggers slide-out navigation drawer from left or right edge
Navigation drawer includes all menu items from desktop left-side navigation
Touch targets meet minimum size requirements (44x44px) for accessibility
Drawer includes smooth open/close animations with backdrop overlay
Navigation drawer closes when user taps backdrop or selects menu item

stories.title: Design Consistent Header with League Identity
stories.goal: see clear league branding and identity in the header across all pages
stories.benefit: I always know which league space I'm in and feel oriented within the application
acceptanceCriteria: Header displays league name prominently using consistent typography
Header shows league logo/icon if available, with fallback to default icon
Header uses league's brand colors or theme colors if configured
Header layout remains consistent across all pages within league clubhouse
Header includes breadcrumb or page title to indicate current location within league
Header design follows Shadcn UI and Tailwind CSS design system patterns

stories.title: Build Global Navigation Controls in Header
stories.goal: access global application features like user profile, settings, and logout from the header
stories.benefit: I can manage my account and access universal features from any page
acceptanceCriteria: Header includes user profile dropdown menu in top-right corner
User menu displays user avatar, name, and email
User menu includes links to account settings, profile management, and logout
User menu provides quick access to notifications if applicable
User menu dropdown is accessible via keyboard navigation
User menu adapts to mobile viewport with appropriate touch interactions

stories.title: Implement Collapsible Left-Side Navigation
stories.goal: collapse or expand the left-side navigation menu to maximize content area
stories.benefit: I can customize my viewing experience based on my current needs
acceptanceCriteria: Navigation menu includes collapse/expand toggle button
Collapsed state shows only icons with tooltips on hover
Expanded state shows full menu item labels alongside icons
Layout smoothly animates transition between collapsed and expanded states
Layout automatically adjusts content area width when navigation state changes
User's navigation state preference persists across sessions

stories.title: Create Consistent Page Container Components
stories.goal: use reusable container components for consistent page layouts
stories.benefit: all pages have uniform structure, spacing, and responsive behavior
acceptanceCriteria: Container component provides consistent max-width and centering for page content
Container includes standard padding and margin values from design system
Container handles overflow and scrolling behavior appropriately
Container supports variants for full-width, constrained, and narrow layouts
Container integrates seamlessly with left navigation and header components
Container component is built with Shadcn UI and Tailwind CSS utilities

stories.title: Build Responsive Navigation Menu Highlighting
stories.goal: clearly see which page I'm currently on via navigation menu highlighting
stories.benefit: I maintain orientation within the league clubhouse and understand my current location
acceptanceCriteria: Active navigation menu item is visually highlighted with distinct background or border
Active state uses color, typography weight, or icon changes for clear indication
Navigation highlighting updates automatically based on current route
Highlighting works correctly in both expanded and collapsed navigation states
Highlighting persists when page reloads or when navigating back via browser controls
Highlighting supports nested menu items or sub-navigation if present

stories.title: Implement Accessible Navigation with Keyboard Support
stories.goal: navigate the entire clubhouse layout using only keyboard controls
stories.benefit: I can use the application efficiently without requiring a mouse
acceptanceCriteria: All navigation menu items are reachable via Tab key navigation
Focus indicators are clearly visible on all interactive navigation elements
Enter or Space key activates navigation links and triggers
Escape key closes mobile navigation drawer and dropdown menus
Skip-to-content link allows bypassing navigation to reach main content quickly
Navigation follows logical tab order matching visual hierarchy

stories.title: Design Loading States for Layout Components
stories.goal: see appropriate loading indicators while page content loads
stories.benefit: I understand the application is working and know when content is ready
acceptanceCriteria: Layout displays skeleton loaders for header and navigation during initial load
Main content area shows loading spinner or skeleton while fetching data
Navigation remains interactive during content loading
Loading states use consistent visual design across all pages
Loading indicators are accessible to screen readers with appropriate ARIA labels
Layout prevents layout shift when transitioning from loading to loaded state

stories.title: Build Error Boundary for Layout Components
stories.goal: see helpful error messages when navigation or layout fails
stories.benefit: I understand what went wrong and can take appropriate action to recover
acceptanceCriteria: Layout includes error boundary component to catch React rendering errors
Error boundary displays user-friendly error message instead of blank screen
Error state provides option to reload page or return to safe location (e.g., home)
Error boundary logs error details for debugging without exposing sensitive info
Error boundary prevents entire application crash when layout component fails
Error boundary includes visual design consistent with application theme
